description: This bar chart, titled "Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time Scaling," presents performance scores across six subplots (a-f) for various large language models on two benchmarks: MATH-500 (subplots a, b, c) and AIME24 (subplots d, e, f). The horizontal axis in each subplot represents different model sizes or configurations, labeled as "3B", "405B", "1.5B", "671B", "7B", "7B", "671B", "unk", and "unk" respectively, while the vertical axis represents performance scores on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100 for MATH-500 subplots (a-c) and from 0 to 90 for AIME24 subplots (d-f). The legend identifies seven distinct model variants: CoT (white), Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (blue hatched), Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct (green), o1-mini (pink), DeepSeek-R1 (tan), o1-preview (brown), and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B (orange), along with GPT-4o (purple hatched). Each subplot contains bars representing the performance of these models under different conditions. In subplot (a), the bars for 3B, unk, and 405B show scores of 78.2, 74.6, and 71.4 respectively. In subplot (b), the bars for 1.5B, unk, and unk show scores of 91.6, 90.0, and 85.5 respectively. In subplot (c), the bars for 671B, 7B, and unk show scores of 97.3, 95.2, and 94.8 respectively. In subplot (d), the bars for 3B, 405B, and unk show scores of 30.0, 23.3, and 9.3 respectively. In subplot (e), the bars for unk, 1.5B, and unk show scores of 63.6, 63.3, and 44.6 respectively. In subplot (f), the bars for 7B, 671B, and unk show scores of 83.3, 79.8, and 79.2 respectively. The bars are visually grouped by model variant and colored according to the legend, with some bars annotated with their exact performance score. The bars are not sorted in any particular order within each subplot.
